    all_words = [tuple(w) for w in itertools.product(range(q), repeat=n)]
    
    # Map word -> index

    # Each codeword covers itself + 7 neighbors (change one of 8 positions to 2 other values)

                    nbrs.add(word_to_idx[tuple(w)])
